name: 13178-batchdecode-qwen3-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, bf16, not substituted. Ungated, ~16.4 GB of weights on an 80 GB card.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. Single GPU is part of the declaration, not incidental.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 320 requests with a 2400 s safety cap; `max-running-requests: 48` is the ceiling on the running batch.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 42, against `/v1/completions`: prompts pinned at exactly 1024 tokens, generations pinned at exactly 512 tokens, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter writing assistant drafting half-page replies from page-long prompts for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented/nested block is DROPPED by the parser, so a structured
# value must stay on ONE line. A bool renders as a bare flag when true and as nothing when false.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1
enable-deterministic-inference: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.8
max-running-requests: 48
